VIT Vault

A local receipt. A separate cloud verification.

Co-developed and deployed an Azure-hosted campus workspace for versioned assignment submissions, course resources, private faculty feedback, and student collaboration.

01 / THE QUESTION

What needed to work?

An assignment submission should have an explicit receipt even when the campus gateway cannot reach the cloud.

Co-developed the Azure-hosted workspace and its campus LAN submission flow, including local receipts, an outbox, deduplication and integrity verification.

Follow the idea through.

LOCAL OUTBOX EXPLANATION

03 / THE ENGINEERING

The decision behind it.

Accept locally and synchronize durably. A local receipt and a cloud-verified file are separate states; SHA-256 identifies the exact content being verified.

  1. 01Campus LAN gateway
  2. 02Local receipt & outbox
  3. 03Durable synchronization
  4. 04Azure verification worker
  • Co-developed an Azure-hosted workspace with versioned submissions, resources, private feedback, and collaboration.
  • Built a campus LAN gateway for submission during internet outages, with local receipts and durable synchronization.
  • Added retry deduplication and SHA-256 integrity checks.
  • Implemented an outbox, a queue-backed verification worker, access-controlled reviews, and isolated non-root Docker coding labs on an Azure VM.
